thesis: The speaker recounts his childhood as a military brat who struggled to form deep connections due to constant moving, which initially led him to rebel against school and authority. A pivotal moment in grade eight occurred when he chose to stay in his room to read a book about bank robbers rather than join friends who subsequently got into serious trouble, leading him to realize he must control his own life trajectory.
